name: load_executable_hunks_with_relocation
description: Program entry that allocates and frees memory through exec and parses AmigaDOS executable hunk records, comparing them against hunk type codes for loading and relocation. It calls an empty stub and three unnamed routines.

name: countdown_then_library_call
description: Runs a countdown loop on a counter and makes an Amiga library call through an offset of minus 210. Two calls come from the find-max routine, and it calls that routine.

name: decode_backward_run_length_bytes
description: Decodes a packed stream into bytes written backwards from a moving buffer pointer, handling run lengths with special cases for the values three and seven. It returns once the pointer reaches the buffer start, and it calls a shifted-flag check and three unnamed routines.

name: shift_multiword_with_extend_flag

name: stub_trap_then_bad_data

name: open_library_jump_entry
description: Boot routine that opens an Amiga library, waits in a loop on one of its functions until it returns non-zero, closes the exec library, and then jumps through a pointer computed from that result. It halts on bad data if the lookup returns zero.

name: open_library_jump_entry
description: Program entry with the same library open, wait, close and jump sequence as the boot routine, and it references dos.library and intuition.library text. It calls three one-instruction routines and one unnamed routine.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data

name: open_dos_and_configure_hardware

name: handle_pointer_entry_stub
description: A four-instruction handler reached by absolute address through a pointer in data. One unnamed routine calls it, and the decompiler gave no code, so only its size and reference are known.

name: depack_stream_using_bit_reader
description: Depacker routine that decodes a packed stream by calling a bit-reader refill routine and a bit-read routine, with two further unnamed calls. Three unnamed routines call it, and the decompiler gave no code.

name: dispatch_to_unnamed_routine

name: read_packed_bit_field

name: set_background_colour_from_bits
description: Reads bits from the packed stream through the bit-reader routine and touches the background colour register, with two further unnamed calls. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: write_countdown_to_colour_register
description: Counts a 16-bit value down from minus one through every value until it wraps back to minus one, writing each value to a global location on each step. It touches the background colour register, and one unnamed routine calls it.

name: copy_block_and_call_handler
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a table into a stack-supplied buffer when that pointer is non-null, then calls through a stored code pointer. Its one unnamed caller reaches it by address.

name: shift_longword_before_pointer
description: Reads the longword four bytes before its input address, shifts it right by one bit, sets the top bit and returns the result. One unnamed routine calls it.

name: refill_shift_bit_buffer
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by one bit per call. When the buffer empties it loads the previous longword with its top bit set, and it repeats for a count taken from an input register before returning.
